Resolves #19866

Release blocker for v13.3 (operator, 2026-10-19): in the flagship workstation, a pane torn out by its tab and carried back over the main window landed in its popup although main previewed the drop, and a second popup returned by its OS title bar never docked. Both shipped with v13.2.0; reversing the post-release dock commits changes neither.

- **The recording's gesture.** `TabSortZone.processDragEnd` sent every detached release to `dockTearOutTerminal`, while `onDragMove` paints in-window previews detached too. A detached release inside the source window's drag boundary is now a re-entry and drops at the release point (ADR 0029 §2.8.6: inside a window the drag is that window's tab-header proxy); outside, it still detaches.
- **Found while proving it.** That re-entry retires a booted vessel, which leaves the Group while the drop's write prepares, and `Commit` refused the drop. `DragAffordances#onDrop` now commits its operation, and `WorkspaceSet#commit` reduces an operation once more at the queue head when the refusal is a membership change (`code: 'participants-changed'`); a whole-document write is never re-sent. Every `commit` caller (the in-window drop, `DockService`'s Neural Link operations, `VesselWorkspace`'s local operations) passes semantic operations.
- **The second title-bar return.** Main's adoption closed the first vessel before the coordinator's committed terminal disposed its park, so `VesselPark` refused every later park. `VesselWorkspace#onNativeWindowRelease` now retires the park of the released window.

Evidence: L2 (unit arms) + real-browser NL arms (Playwright Chromium, the real mouse, CDP window moves as the OS window server) → L3 required (AC1–AC3); the operator's own gesture is post-merge. Residual: AC5, Residual-Owner: #19652

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC1 | `WorkstationPopupReturnNL.spec.mjs`: "a vessel carried back over the main window's edge drops its pane where main previewed it", booted and still booting: the pane lands in the node the accepted preview names (`data-dock-target`), owned by no vessel, and the vessel closes |
| AC2 | same spec: "a second popped-out pane docks back by its OS titlebar after the first one did" |
| AC3 | `DockTabSortZone.spec.mjs`: "released DETACHED just outside its window still detaches"; the walk-back arm "a pane carried back inside while its vessel still boots stays home, and the vessel closes" |
| AC4 | unit arms in `DockTabSortZone.spec.mjs`, `Workspace.spec.mjs`, and `DockWorkspaceSetTransaction.spec.mjs` (the real Group: a member leaves mid-preparation and the operation lands; it is reduced once only; a document write is never re-sent); directories below |
| AC5 | post-merge (operator) |

## Test Evidence

- **Red first.** Without the fixes the three regression arms fail (the second title-bar return, both edge drops) and the walk-back arm passes. Without only the retry, the booted edge drop failed 4/4 with the refused write traced (`participant membership, generation or revision changed during preparation`). With all fixes: 12/12 over three repeats. The unit arms red on reverting each production change; retrying twice instead of once reds the once-only arm.
- **Units.** `test/playwright/unit/{dashboard,apps/workstation,draggable,manager}`: 1817 passed, 2 skipped at `0139f72560`.
- **Final head.** `WorkstationPopupReturnNL.spec.mjs` ×3: 12/12.
- **Dock e2e subset** (16 workstation NL specs, 55 tests, `--workers=1`): 51 passed, 3 skipped, 1 failed. The failure was `WorkstationFiveBeatNL` scene 5: main never claimed the stack return while the pointer moved, before any release. It ran while my unit runs loaded the CPU. Since then it is 5/5 green (alone ×3; the whole file ×2, 22 passed and 6 skipped). An earlier session recorded the same `ready:false` symptom on `dev` (2026-08-02). An earlier full-battery run was void: my parallel runs clobbered the shared `test-results` directory.
- Hosted CI runs the NL tier (`e2e-brain`, blocking), so these arms run on every dev-based Engine PR in its impact boundary. Correction: an earlier version of this line said the tier did not run in CI; it has since 2026-10-13.

## Deltas from ticket

- The third change (operation commit + retry) was not in the ticket's first body; the ticket now carries it in The Fix and the Contract Ledger.
- Not fixed here: a native drop that arrives while main still settles a previous return is abandoned on its first null preview instead of awaiting `answerWhenPreviewable` (a follow-up); the arm pauses 1.5 s between the two returns, a human's pace.

## Commits

- `46a74af9ca`: the three fixes, unit arms, the NL spec
- `0139f72560`: Euclid's review: the retry writes the admitted snapshot, only into the Group that admitted it (two arms, red-first)

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] The operator's recorded gesture (tab tear-out, carry back over main, release on the previewed zone) and a second title-bar return both reintegrate on the merged build.

Response to [5574863261](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/19867#pullrequestreview-5574863261). Head `0139f72560`; the delta is one commit.

**RA-1 [P2], preserve the admitted request and Group across the retry: [ADDRESSED]** in `0139f72560`. `WorkspaceSet#commit` now:
- snapshots `{operations, options}` once (`Neo.clone(…, true)`), so both attempts write that snapshot;
- pins the `groupId` its first attempt resolved;
- retries only while `resolveGroupId()` still returns it. A host rebound to another Group gets the original `participants-changed` refusal, and neither Group is written.

One retry and the no-document-replay rule stay as they were.

Your two arms sit beside the once-only/control arms in `DockWorkspaceSetTransaction.spec.mjs`:
- "a retried operation writes what was admitted, not what its caller changed since";
- "a retry does not follow a host rebound to another Group: the refusal surfaces, and neither Group is written".

Red-first against `46a74af9ca`: the first received `locked: false`, the second resolved instead of rejecting. Green with the fix.
